title: Morbidity in Adults With Craniofacial Fibrous Dysplasia: The CRANIO-DF Study
official: Morbidity, Management, and Outcomes in Adults With Craniofacial Fibrous Dysplasia: A National Multicenter Retrospective Study Using the EasyHYBRID-DF Database
summary: Fibrous dysplasia is a rare bone disorder in which normal bone is replaced by fibro-osseous tissue. Craniofacial involvement may be associated with substantial morbidity and complex multidisciplinary care. CRANIO-DF aims to describe morbidity, management and outcomes in adults with craniofacial fibrous dysplasia using the French national EasyHYBRID-DF database.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 years or older
* Diagnosis of fibrous dysplasia recorded in HYBRID-DF
* Craniofacial involvement recorded in HYBRID-DF
* No objection to reuse of data for research

Exclusion Criteria:

* Erroneous diagnosis of fibrous dysplasia recorded in HYBRID-DF
* Available data do not allow craniofacial involvement to be established
